text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okay! What should we ride next? The Ferris wheel? A roller coaster?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Oh! Look over there, Mayano! I see something marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Fly High as a VR Pilot?! Looks fun! Let's give it a whirl!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: …All right, pilots! Your mission—avoid enemy fire and return safely to base!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ratatatata! Look at these small fry! Did they really think I'd fall for a trap like that?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Incredible work! ☆ You're like some kind of mind-reading super genius. ★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh? If you just imagine what they're seeing, it's pretty easy to predict—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmmm, wait a second. Maybe I could use this strategy in races too!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelous! ☆ That was so fun! ★ What should we do next?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Marvey! I just really wanna go race right now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: An idea struck me like an enemy missile earlier. Now I wanna try reading my opponents in a race!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Is that a challenge?! What a marvelous idea! ☆ I accept. ★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Nice! Thanks so much! Let's hurry back to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun and Marvelous Sunday
Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a result of her epiphany at the theme park, all of Mayano Top Gun's racing skills increase!
